assets.prompt:
Use case: stylized-concept.
Asset type: one transparent, full-body idle character master for a polished Chinese fantasy web platform's Login page, P3 character presence. Create ONLY Artoria Pendragon (Saber), recognizable canonical character identity, depicted as an adult woman, calm, earnest and reassuring, in her fully clothed classic royal-blue and silver armored knight dress.
Subject: blonde hair with neat braided bun, small upward ahoge and blue hair ribbon, clear green eyes, composed friendly closed-mouth smile. Silver breastplate and articulated gauntlets over a royal-blue long-sleeved dress, layered ankle-length blue-and-ivory skirt, armored boots. No exposed midriff, no cleavage, no sexualized styling. A sheathed blue-and-gold knightly sword rests upright close to her left side, held gently with one gauntleted hand; the other hand relaxed near her waist. Restrained upright three-quarter pose, head gently turned toward the viewer, shoulders subtly oriented to the viewer's right toward the separate authentication panel. Only one character.
Style/medium: premium detailed Japanese anime game key-art, elegant precise linework, painterly cloth folds and polished but restrained silver-metal rendering, not photorealism, not chibi, not flat vector. Harmonize with a bright Royal Observatory art direction: ivory-white, royal azure, moonlit soft blue; warm soft daylight on face and cool pale-blue edge light. Restrained highlights, excellent readable silhouette, graceful natural adult proportions.
Composition/framing: portrait 2:3, request 2048x3072 pixels; full body from ahoge to boot soles, complete sword and every finger. Entire silhouette centered, feet on the same implied horizontal ground level, 7-8 percent clear transparent margins around head, hair, dress, hands, sword and feet. Narrow relaxed silhouette suitable for reuse as full-body, three-quarter, waist-up and mobile head/shoulder crops. No wide outstretched arms, no dynamic combat or wind-blown cape.
Background: genuinely transparent PNG RGBA alpha. Every pixel outside the character and carried sword must be transparent; do not render a white, gray, black or checkerboard background. No ground plane or cast shadow, no buildings, no window, no moon, no sky, no scenery, no floating particles, no frame, no glow cloud. Character alone with clean antialiased transparent edges.
Text: none. Absolutely no UI, buttons, form fields, labels, logos, watermarks, signatures or written symbols. Do not combine character and background into one illustration.

validation.visual_review: Recognizable blonde/green-eyed Saber, blue/silver full knight dress, sheathed upright sword, complete hair/boots/sword; generated output inspected once.
